roads.name: VGIN Virginia Road Centerlines (VBMP RCL)
roads.agency: Virginia Geographic Information Network (VGIN) / VDEM, with local governments and VDOT
roads.county_filter: MFIPS = 5-digit state+county FIPS string (e.g. '51179' = Stafford, '51760' = Richmond City). 133 VA localities present (95 counties + 38 cities) plus one 7-char code '5120752'. Also FIPS_L / FIPS_R per side. Layer includes some border-state segments (MFIPS 11xxx/21xxx/24xxx/37xxx...), so filter MFIPS LIKE '51%' for VA-only.
roads.vintage: Dynamic dataset, re-extracted quarterly by VGIN. Live max GEO_ED / ST_ED = 2026-09-21; max GEO_EFFDT = 2026-09-15; min GEO_EFFDT = 2017-03-13.
roads.live_test: OK 2026-10-12: where MFIPS='51179' AND ST_FULL LIKE 'Garrisonville%' returned OBJECTID 111296 / RCL_ID 646726 / ST_FULL 'Garrisonville Rd' / MTFCC S1200LOC / VDOT_RNUM 610 (SC) / VDOT_RNAM R-VA089SC00610WB / 35 mph, polyline geometry in 3857; layer count 660386 (659441 with MFIPS LIKE '51%')
roads.use_terms: Copyright: Virginia Geographic Information Network (VGIN). VGIN's RCL description (as republished on Roanoke County / Campbell County mirrors of this dataset) says: RCL geometry is public domain; minimal attribution (RCL Public) is public domain; geocoding fields (RCL Master) are restricted, contact VGIN for those. The VGIN service itself shows no license text beyond the copyright line.
roads.standard: VITA ITRM OTH 703-00 Road Centerline Geospatial Data Standard: https://vginmaps.vdem.virginia.gov/download/standards/VAOTH703_VirginiaRCLDataStandardOTH70300.pdf
roads.notes: Statewide local streets + highways (not highway-only). Layer 5 ('< 50,000', minScale 1:50,000) and layer 4 ('> 49,999') are the same full 660,386-feature set split only by display scale; scale limits do not affect REST queries. No datum shift applied; data recorded as served in Web Mercator. The user still picks the output CRS (VA North 6593 / South 6595).
